notes.title: Localization & Release Update
notes.content:
Launch Update

We’ve made the tough decision to delay the release of Boomerang Jack, now coming a few months later than planned. Our goal has always been to deliver a polished, exciting adventure from day one, and we need a bit more time to make sure it’s the best it can be.


We’re also excited to confirm that Boomerang Jack will launch with full localization -- English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Italian, Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Turkish and more! 

In the meantime, we’ll keep sharing progress updates and behind-the-scenes looks as we wrap up development. Thank you so much for your patience, your wishlists, and your support, it means the world to us and helps us bring Boomerang Jack to life the right way.

— The Recall Interactive Team
